 Computational analysis via DharmaNexus registers extensive internal text reuse across the Abhidhamma corpus, identifying 96 matching passages shared with 30 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most significant structural correspondences occur with other *Paṭṭhāna* sections treating defilement dyads and related matrices, particularly the *Kilesagocchaka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.12; 12 matches, sharing §§ 1.1–3.1 with §§ 55.1–57.1), the *Kilesagocchaka* (Patthana 2.12), the *Tika Hetuduka* (Patthana 4.1), and the *Saṁkiliṭṭhaduka* (Patthana 8.51; sharing §§ 0.2–3.1) [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches meeting the alignment threshold are recorded [DharmaNexus].
